query: INSERT INTO operation_receipts (operation_id, consumer, subject_id, status, request_fingerprint, result_json, error_json, created_at, updated_at, terminal_at, sequence) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'running', ?, NULL, NULL, ?, ?, NULL, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM operation_receipts), 0) + 1) ON CONFLICT(operation_id) DO NOTHING
